_comment: Default quick links, data only. The biweekly Cronsole Source Scout keeps these URLs current and adds AI tools that schedule work; it may edit this file and nothing else under frontend/. quickLinks.test.ts checks that every shipped source (SOURCE_DOCS) has a link here or a reason in noWebConsole, that ids are unique and every URL is https. A new id reaches existing installs once (quickLinkDefaultsSeen); a link someone deleted is never brought back.

noWebConsole.WINDOWS_TASK_SCHEDULER: Task Scheduler is a desktop app on the machine, not a web page.
noWebConsole.TASKHUB_NATIVE: Cronsole-native jobs live in Cronsole itself; there is nothing else to open.
noWebConsole.N8N: Every install runs its own n8n instance at its own address, so no one URL is right; add yours with Add link.
